correctness.rationale: Every expanded hyperedge must contain exactly one chosen vertex in any inclusion-maximal strong independent set: at most one by definition and at least one because otherwise a private vertex may be added. Its original chosen vertices X are graph-independent; each untouched edge independently chooses one of r-2 private vertices. Conversely all omitted originals have positive degree and are blocked by a represented edge, yielding the full exact bijection. Size = m-sum_X(deg(v)-1), giving min m-alpha_w and max m, matching-only well-covered boundary. The #P metric reduction joins an arbitrary nonempty graph to a universal vertex; I(Q join K1;1)=I(Q;1)+1. Independent exhaustive direct instances K3,r3 and C4,r4 matched polynomials.
